title: Image loading follows the likely main image
why: Lazy loading on the largest image slows the page.
changelog: `` sets fetchpriority on the first image of at least 50000 square pixels or unknown size
in `{#each}` only the first iteration gets priority and the first 3 are not lazy; `{#if}` branches own their priority
Markdown images get `decoding="async"`, the same loading rule and their size from `public/`
